overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action and found no Open Meeting Law violation, because there was insufficient evidence that anyone was denied access to the remotely held June 9 open session.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged several teachers' association members were locked out of the June 9 Zoom meeting and denied access to the open session.
allegations.key_passage: We find insufficient evidence to conclude that any individual was denied access to the Committee’s June 9 open session meeting while the meeting was ongoing and we therefore do not find a violation of the Open Meeting Law.
